name: TextField
intent: Lets the user enter or edit short text, numbers, emails or passwords, or longer text with multiline. Always has a visible label; shows guidance and validation errors underneath. Combine inside forms, Cards and Dialogs, stacked vertically with space.md between fields.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Never rely on placeholder as the label.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the field loses focus — validate here.

props.name: type
props.description: Input type; picks the mobile keyboard and autofill.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: An example of the expected format.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Short guidance under the field. Replaced by error.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Puts the field in the error state; say what is wrong and how to fix it.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Visible and submitted but not editable.

props.name: size
props.description: sm for dense layouts like tables and filters.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the input element, e.g. to focus it.

sizes.name: sm
sizes.intent: Dense UI: tables, filter bars, toolbars.

when: Free-form input the user types: names, emails, search terms, comments.
Numbers where a slider or stepper would be slower.

whenNot.situation: Choosing one option from a known list

composition: Stack fields vertically with space.md between them.
Show errors after blur or submit, not while the user is still typing.
Put the submit Button after the last field, aligned with the fields.

notes: The label is linked to the input; helper and error text are linked with aria-describedby.
Error state sets aria-invalid. The message must explain how to fix the problem.
Required fields are marked with an asterisk and aria-required.

examples.title: With error
examples.code: <TextField label="Email" value={email} onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)} error="Enter an email like name@company.com" />
